notes: Who's in the seat: key seats for a place (agency heads, regulators, central bank, key boards). A seat is listed only after the holder is confirmed on an official page (agency site, Senate or House committee page, Federal Register, agency release, SEC 8-K Item 5.02). Each seat keeps its source link and the date it was checked. No placeholder names.
